title: Build Mobile Apps with React Native
tagline: Use the React you know to ship a real iOS and Android app with Expo.
description: React Native lets you write one React codebase that renders real native views on iPhone and Android. You'll build Trailhead, a hiking-log app, from an empty Expo project to a build on a real phone: screens, lists, navigation, forms, GPS, photos, reminders and offline storage, each added in the lesson that teaches it.

The course is honest about what's different on mobile: no cascade, column-first flexbox, the keyboard covering your form, permissions users can refuse, and release cycles that go through app review. You'll finish by debugging, testing and shipping with EAS Build, Submit and Update, the same pipeline teams use in production.
audience: Web developers who know React and want to build and ship their first iOS and Android app.
prerequisites: Comfortable with React components, props, state and hooks, plus modern JavaScript (async/await, array methods).
learnItems: Explain how React Native renders native views, not a WebView
Lay out screens with StyleSheet, flexbox and safe areas
Build fast lists with FlatList and SectionList
Navigate with Expo Router stacks, tabs, params and modals
Use storage, location, camera and notifications safely
Debug, test and ship builds and OTA updates with EAS
